stem.text: For a certain endothermic reaction, the activation energy is numerically equal to twice the enthalpy change of reaction.
Which reaction pathway diagram is correct for this reaction?

A.alt: Energy profile graph: products level higher than reactants; one tall peak well above both levels.

B.alt: Energy profile graph: products level higher than reactants; one small peak above both levels.

C.alt: Energy profile graph: products level lower than reactants; one peak above reactants.

D.alt: Energy profile graph: products level lower than reactants; one tall narrow peak.
